hero.subtitle: Launch a beautiful multilingual page, take bookings that can never overbook a session, and run guests, payments and growth from one calm dashboard.

why.title: Everything a studio needs, nothing it doesn't
why.intro: We built the tools small studios keep asking for, and left out the clutter.

page.title: A page that does the selling
page.body: Pick a template, edit ready-made sections and publish in minutes. Your studio gets a professional landing page with its own address, no designer or developer required.

seats.title: Bookings that never overbook
seats.body: Every booking reserves its seat safely, even when many guests book at once. When a session is full, it says so, and you never have to apologise.

languages.title: Speak your guests' language
languages.body: Publish in English, Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese and Chinese. Guests read and book in the language they choose.

payments.title: Know who has paid
payments.body: Record cash, card and transfer payments and refunds on every booking, and see your income at a glance.

guests.title: Guests who come back
guests.body: Keep every guest and their booking history together. Check guests in on the day and see who is coming.

growth.title: Growth built in
growth.body: Guests can earn by sharing your workshops with an affiliate link or by inviting friends, so your community helps you grow.

how.title: From idea to first booking in three steps

create.title: Create your shop
create.body: Sign up, choose your address and languages, add your contact details.

design.title: Build your page
design.body: Choose a template, edit sections, add your workshops and schedule sessions.

share.title: Publish and take bookings
share.body: Publish with one click, no review needed. Guests book a seat and you manage everything from your dashboard.

guests.title: A booking experience guests love
guests.intro: Happy guests book again and tell their friends. We make every step easy for them.

book.title: Book in a few taps
book.body: Pick a session, choose how many seats and you are done. A confirmation arrives by email.

today.title: A personal Today page
today.body: Guests see today's workshops, check in on the day and get directions in one tap.

favorites.title: Workshops picked for them
favorites.body: Guests choose favorite categories and see matching workshops first, while every shop gets its turn in the spotlight.

earn.title: Rewards for sharing
earn.body: Guests earn when friends book through their link or sign up with their invitation, and can request a withdrawal.

q1.a: No. Pick a template and edit text and images in the builder. We take care of hosting, your address and bookings.

q2.a: No. Seats are reserved safely at the moment of booking, so a full session stays full.

q3.a: Your page and the guest area work in English, Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese and Chinese.

q4.q: Does my landing page need approval?
q4.a: No. When you publish, your page goes live right away.

q5.q: How do I keep track of payments?
q5.a: You record each payment (cash, card or bank transfer) and any refund on the booking, so you always know who has paid.

cta.title: Ready to fill your next session?
cta.body: Create your shop in a few minutes and give your guests a reason to book today.

footer.tagline: The booking platform for workshop studios.

hero.title: We help makers share what they love
hero.subtitle: Workshop Platform exists so that every studio, from a pottery corner to a busy cooking school, can welcome guests with the same care it puts into its craft.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body1: Running a workshop is hard work: teaching, preparing, answering messages, chasing payments. Too often the booking side steals the time that belongs to the craft.
mission.body2: We build simple, reliable tools that take that weight away: a page that sells, a calendar that never double-books and a dashboard that tells you what matters today.

craft.title: Respect for craft
craft.body: Workshops are made by people who care. Our software stays out of the way and makes their work look its best.

trust.title: Trust by default
trust.body: Seats, payments and personal data are handled with care. Important actions are recorded in an audit trail, so questions always have answers.

simple.title: Simple on purpose
simple.body: Every feature has to save a studio time. If it only adds clutter, it does not ship.

fair.title: Fair to every shop
fair.body: Guests discover workshops from many studios, and we rotate who is shown first so small shops get seen too.

a.title: Made for workshops, not generic events
a.body: Sessions, seats, schedules, check-in and workshop pages are the heart of the product, not an afterthought.

b.title: Many languages, one place
b.body: Serve guests in five languages without keeping five websites.

c.title: Support that is human
c.body: Need help? The platform team is one message away, from your dashboard or from this site.

cta.title: Let's build something together
cta.body: Tell us about your studio, or start your page today.
